chunks: "Begone," said (God), "contemptible and rejected! As for those who follow you, I shall fill up Hell with all of you."
ai.seo_question: What did God say to Satan after he refused to bow to Adam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the definitive expulsion of Iblis from divine grace, emphasizing his transition from a lofty status to one of eternal disgrace (madh'um) and banishment (madh'hur). The declaration that Hell will be filled with him and his followers underscores the cosmic consequence of his prideful disobedience, establishing the archetype for human deviation from Adam's path.
